title: TrainingShard
description: Schema definition for local persistent training state of one dataset shard for one model version.

id.description: Unique local identifier (UUID4) for the persisted TrainingShard.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model being trained.

model_type.description: Identifies the distributed training engine model type / architecture.

model_version.description: Version of the global model checkpoint against which this shard is trained.

dataset_id.description: Identifier of the dataset from which the shard was created.

artifact_path.description: Local filesystem path to the dataset shard artifact.

sample_count.description: Number of training samples contained in the shard (strictly positive).

metrics.description: Arbitrary training execution metrics produced by training operation.

update_artifact_path.description: Local filesystem path to the generated training update/delta artifact.

training_task_id.description: Identifier of the assigned training task.
